policy.notes: Populate paths with laboratory data. Do not replace missing measurements with guessed values for calibrated claims.

materials.notes: The axicon glass must be supplied from manufacturer documentation or measurement before broadband dispersion is treated as calibrated.

required_measurements_for_absolute_bench: laser beam radius/ellipticity and physical input-plane registration
SLM1 and SLM2 phase LUTs at the actual wavelength, incidence and polarisation
4F focal lengths, separations, iris radius and +1 order position
axicon glass/material, angle convention, clear aperture and centre
objective NA, focal length, effective pupil radius and pupil mapping
camera object-plane scale, rotation, centre and saturation/background
pulse energy and optical transmissions for absolute fluence
